svg.title: Six input methods, one contract, one back end
svg.text: Six input methods, one contract, one back end
What you bring decides where the picture's timing comes from. Everything after controls.json is shared.
S7 checks, sync on the ring
The master is what you hear. Stems and MIDI only steer the picture; E without a master plays the stems' sum.
Each method has its own inbox and run folders; datapipe example master|stems|midi shows the layout.
Purple rows take their timing from notes (the score or MIDI), exact to the frame; blue rows detect it.
Each method has its own mapping onto the look; the S7 sync gate checks the track the light ring follows.
Songs keep their length: a warning over 60 s, refused over 180 s. A is an 8-second seamless loop.
Everything after controls.json is one back end: the same Blender look, encode and checks for all six.
